description: Installation of one 42 inch internally Illuminated LCD media screen and two 1250 mm x 700 mm flag pole signs, overall 2400 mm in height
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (02_3324_2A, 02_3324_2C, 02_3324_2B and Unnumbered Site Location Plan) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
